title: neobassia proceriflora
intro: Neobassia proceriflora, commonly known as Bassia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Amaranthaceae. It is native to Western Asia and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Bassia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
